key.name: workspace-layout-orientation
key.summary: The order workspaces fill the grid in
key.description: With "horizontal" the workspaces fill each row from the left, starting with the top row. With "vertical" they fill each column from the top, starting with the left column.

key.name: workspace-layout-rows
key.description: The number of rows in the workspace grid. 0 derives it from the number of columns and the number of workspaces. If the rows and the columns are both 0, the workspaces are in one row.

key.name: workspace-layout-columns
key.description: The number of columns in the workspace grid. 0 derives it from the number of rows and the number of workspaces. If the rows and the columns are both set and the grid is too small for the workspaces, a horizontal grid gets more columns and a vertical one more rows.
